case.name: Prof. Isabelle Fournier
topics: large language models for task planning

result.subject: Request for Lab Tour During Engineering Expedition
result.body:
Your work on embodied AI at UC Berkeley has significantly advanced our understanding of human-robot interaction. We are a small group of engineering students visiting the San Francisco Bay Area to explore cutting-edge research in robotics and AI. We write to seek guidance and insight from your expertise.

We are particularly interested in your research on large language models for task planning, as it aligns closely with our project on autonomous systems. The group hopes to learn how these models can be integrated into real-world applications and what challenges you have encountered in this domain.

We would be honored to request a 30-minute lab tour during our visit, if possible. We are happy to adapt to your schedule and are flexible with the timing. Thank you for considering our request.
